rationale: Post-contingency state with l13 out has l12 overloaded at 100 MW (133% of 75 MW rating). Closing tie line l14 (x=0.3 pu) provides an alternative path from bus 1 to bus 4, reducing flow on l12 to approximately 70.7 MW (within rating). All other branch flows also remain within their emergency ratings. Network remains connected.
